content_blocks.title: The core idea
content_blocks.text: Iterators describe a sequence of values and compose transformations. Many adaptors are lazy, so a terminal operation such as collect, sum, or for_each is needed to consume the sequence.

content_blocks.title: A reliable way to reason about it
